**Review: not ready to publish**

**Claims list**
| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| Visited the Darjeeling garden that grows our first flush | Origin/team fact, fine as written |
| Leaves picked in March, taste bright and floral | Product fact, fine |
| In the shop from Monday | New arrival, fine |
| "only 40 tins are left, so be quick" | **Unsupported** |

**Problem: unverified scarcity**
"Only 40 tins are left, so be quick" is a stock number and an urgency push. The allowlist doesn't cover it, and nothing in this chat confirms it. Scarcity language is only acceptable if it's real and verifiable. There's also a logic gap: the tea isn't in the shop until Monday, so "are left" is odd before any have sold. If 40 tins is the total run, say that plainly. If you can confirm the number from your stock system, it can stay in a factual form.

**Compliant version (if the 40-tin run is confirmed)**
> This month we visited the garden in Darjeeling that grows our first flush. The leaves are picked in March and taste bright and floral. You'll find it in the shop from Monday. We have a single run of 40 tins.

**If it isn't confirmed**
> This month we visited the garden in Darjeeling that grows our first flush. The leaves are picked in March and taste bright and floral. You'll find it in the shop from Monday.

```json
{"issues": [{"quote": "only 40 tins are left, so be quick", "type": "fake_urgency"}], "publish": false}
```
